The Bharat Index

A source-led view of India from 1947 through October 2026.

How to read the timeline

The slider covers every calendar year from 1947 to 2026. Each indicator begins only at its earliest source-backed observation; the timeline does not imply continuous coverage from 1947. A fiscal-year observation is positioned at its ending year; its original period remains in the label. A blank year or hatched state means the cited source did not publish an observation for that period. The index does not interpolate, generate its own estimates, carry values forward, or treat missing data as zero.

National-only indicators are identified as such. The map uses a neutral fill for those years and does not imply a state-level value. State and UT values appear only when a government or original data-publisher source provides them.

Survey rounds, Census years, fiscal years, administrative snapshots, and scientific estimates measure different things. Where definitions change, the series note identifies the break. “No published observation” means exactly that; it is not a claim that the underlying condition was absent.

Each selected observation shows its source type, reference period, and release status. Tags distinguish Census, Survey, and Administrative data. State DES series and foodgrain production are tagged as official estimates; UNDP HDI is tagged as an international index. “Provisional,” “final,” and “advance estimate” are used only where the source identifies that status; otherwise the status is “Published.” A one-observation series is labelled as a snapshot and shown without a trend line. Programme and security categories start collapsed, and additional security context stays closed until opened.

Source audit date: 24 October 2026. The latest released observation varies by indicator; the slider’s 2026 endpoint does not imply that every series has a 2026 value.

Release status and comparability

The last published decennial population census is Census 2011. Census 2027 has not yet published population results; this index does not substitute population projections for census counts. Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India.

The Economic Census series stops at the published Sixth Economic Census; the seventh round is not presented as a released result. The Agriculture Census series stops at published 2015–16 results; no 2020–21 result is invented. See the MoSPI FAQ and Agriculture Census programme page.

State GDP / NSDP observations shown here use the published 2011–12 base-year table. India’s national accounts have moved to a 2022–23 base; this index keeps the older state series labelled and separate. The annual-average CPI series uses the 2012=100 series through 2025. CPI 2024=100 has a revised basket and methodology; its latest September 2026 year-on-year rate is shown as a separate monthly snapshot. No annual 2026 figure is inferred or spliced across bases.
